bugClass: missing case / unguarded undefined -> crash (NaN coercion) on short versions
bugSummary: For one- or two-segment versions the patch segment s[2] is undefined; the pre-release check did `(s1[2] + s2[2]).indexOf('-')`, but undefined+undefined is NaN (a number), so calling .indexOf on it throws a TypeError. The fix coerces the missing patch segment to ''.
triggerInput: compareVersions('10','10') must return 0; the buggy version throws TypeError "(s1[2] + s2[2]).indexOf is not a function". Also compareVersions('1','1'), compareVersions('1-alpha','1'). Three-segment comparisons work in both.
